mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO cash_point_earn_history (cash_point_id, coupon_id, amount, remaining_amount, earned_date, expired_date) VALUES (#{cashPointId}, #{couponId}, #{amount}, #{remainingAmount}, #{earnedDate}, #{expiredDate})
mapper.select: SELECT id, cash_point_id, coupon_id, amount, remaining_amount, earned_date, expired_date FROM cash_point_earn_history WHERE cash_point_id = #{cashPointId} AND remaining_amount > 0 AND expired_date >= #{today} ORDER BY earned_date ASC, id ASC
